quality.reason: Excellent down-report: specific diagnostics (failed remediation steps, logged-out landing page evidence), failure chronology (day 3 X login, day 108 Reddit block), last-known-good reference, and a precise human action item with owner and expected recovery path — exactly the actionable escalation a broken scanner should emit.

Well-structured with genuinely actionable elements (specific whale position changes, concrete PnL/WR stats, funding rate snapshot), but broken empty ticker tags on 2 of 3 news items, flat market deltas carrying little signal, and no prioritization or synthesis across the 20 alerts keep it short of high value.

Highly actionable, well-structured review with precise risk flags (SOL 0.70% from stop, sentiment conflicts with confidence levels), statistically grounded strategy health (sample sizes, Sharpe, t-stats, hysteresis thresholds), and correct signal-vs-noise discrimination such as discounting a challenger ranking built on n=2 trades.

Well-structured whale digest with specific wallet-level position flips, an actionable market table (price, OI, funding, book imbalance), and a concrete BTC buy alert with size and price; minor deductions for inconsistent L/S notation and a few bare entries lacking absolute position sizes.

Well-structured digest with a genuinely actionable forward-looking item (Senate CLARITY Act vote in 2 days with clear market implications), proper sourcing URL, tiered impact labels, and appropriately calibrated secondary item, though the XRP inflow item is relatively minor.

Dense, current-dated report with specific actionable items — broken x-scanner login, dead meta cron, tripped risk breaker with containment status, quantified signal waste, and a concrete whale-positioning alpha signal into FOMC — all with deltas and day-counts that enable prioritized follow-up.

Highly actionable critical alert with specific service, quantified evidence (68h stale, 16 scans/0 tweets), likely root cause, and explicit remediation step, plus a concise clean-status confirmation for governance.

Well-structured digest with a highly relevant paper summary, specific verified metrics, useful 'why it matters' analysis, transparent methodology notes including graceful fallback after API rate-limiting, and consistent metadata (arXiv ID matches date, out-of-sample period coherent) — clear actionable signal rather than noise.
